scope: Equipment previewer presentation and component icons

original_painted_icon_audit.problem: Pale paper and shadow backing remained inside some extracted cutouts.

observed_examples.finding: Paper patches beneath headwear, inside open headbands, or between hanging side panels.
Pale ground strips beneath feet or retained paper bridging the gap between legs.

original_painted_icon_audit.resolution: Every preview icon now uses an actual 3D component render with alpha transparency; painted cutouts are not used by the preview detail panel.

render_capture.source: Existing client actor, fitted equipment meshes, registered rigid bow scenes
excluded: generated fitting liners and hidden fitting envelopes
render_capture.bow_capture_fix: Longbow and Recurve Bow use registered rigid scenes rather than the actor-hidden socketed copies.
render_capture.fitting_liner_capture_fix: Generated boot and body fitting liners are excluded so capture silhouettes contain only authored equipment surfaces.

identity_policy: Preview labels and descriptions change; canonical item IDs, equipment visuals, game stats, and historical replay identifiers are preserved.
